join_order.notes: Scan keyword.keyword (134170 rows), collect k_ids whose keyword matches any of 8 literals. Also compute MIN(k.keyword) over matches inline.

join_order.build: t_ids surviving keyword join (dedup via bitset over title rows)
join_order.notes: Use bitset(2528312) over title to dedup t_ids from CSR expansion; then iterate set bits and apply year filter; survivors go into a compact vector of qualifying t_ids.
For each t_id, scan ci range [ci_off[t_id], ci_off[t_id+1]); accumulate (t_id, pid) work. Also maintain candidate MIN(t.title) over qualifying t_ids.
name.id is identity/dense; name_row = pid - 1. Maintain a bitset(4167491) of seen pids to skip duplicate varlen reads when comparing against current MIN(n.name).

data_structures.keyword_literals: small sorted array of 8 std::string_view + per-row strcmp during scan
data_structures.t_id_dedup: bitset of size 2528312 over title row space
data_structures.seen_pid: bitset of size 4167491 to avoid repeated name varlen reads

parallelism.notes: Phase A (keyword scan + CSR expansion + year filter): single-threaded; output is small (~thousands of t_ids). Phase B (per-t_id cast_info probe with name MIN): parallelize over qualifying_t_ids in morsels; each thread keeps local seen_pid bitset (4167491 bits ~520KB ok) and local mins; reduce mins at end. seen_pid may also be a shared atomic bitset to reduce duplicate work but per-thread is simpler and acceptable.

indexes.purpose: join_lookup: keyword_id -> mk row ids (CSR offsets + rowids)
